---
name: Bug
about: Something nota does wrong
labels: ["type:bug"]
---

## What happens

What you did, what nota did, and what you expected instead.

## How to see it

Steps, the command, or the test that shows it. Never attach a recording or
a transcript; describe it, or use invented text.

## Version

`nota --version`, or the commit you built from, and your system (distribution,
PipeWire or PulseAudio).
